Off-Screen Life

Art & Tech Philosophy

I believe art and technology aren't opposites but complementary forces. While code allows me to build functional solutions, art lets me explore abstract ideas and emotions. Both require creativity, patience, and a willingness to iterate until you achieve your vision.

My Creative Process

1

Inspiration

Ideas come from everywhere - a debugging session, a sunset, or a mathematical concept

2

Sketching

Quick sketches to capture the essence before it fades

3

Experimentation

Trying different mediums and techniques - much like testing different algorithms

4

Creation

The focused flow state where time disappears - similar to coding

5

Reflection

Stepping back to assess and iterate - art is never truly finished

Beyond the Canvas

Other passions that fuel my creativity

Photography

Capturing moments through a different lens - mainly street photography and nature shots

Hiking & Trekking

Exploring trails and mountains - my best ideas often come during long hikes

Reading

Science fiction, philosophy, and biographies of innovators fuel my imagination

Music

From classical Indian ragas to lo-fi beats - music is my coding companion

Cooking

Experimenting with fusion recipes - algorithms in the kitchen!

Board Games

Strategy games and chess - training ground for problem-solving
